description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox text-to-speech without a reference audio prompt.

unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The pinned FL_ChatterboxTTS node does not expose a duration control; output length follows the text and model prosody.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speed: The standard Chatterbox TTS node exposes cfg_weight/pace, not a direct speed control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.remove_silence: The pinned Chatterbox node pack does not expose silence trimming in this node.
unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_ref: Reference audio is handled by the chatterbox_tts_vc_comfy workflow when a file is supplied.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact generated by the local Chatterbox TTS node.
